name: dw-criminal-defense
description: Daniels & Washington criminal-defense toolkit — 69 skills across 8 plugins plus dw-core foundation.

plugins.name: dw-core
plugins.description: Foundation: session persistence, shared protocols, data contracts, master orchestrator, case dashboard, and skill index. Every other dw plugin depends on this.

plugins.name: dw-intake-discovery
plugins.description: Client intake interview plus discovery orchestration, compliance monitoring, and Brady/Giglio audit.

plugins.name: dw-evidence-audit
plugins.description: Methodology and reliability audits across all evidence types: forensics, interrogations, eyewitness ID, cell-site, video, social media, lab, DNA, chain of custody.

plugins.name: dw-offense-specialists
plugins.description: Element-by-element defense theory for drug, DWI, firearms, sex, and violent-crime charges.

plugins.name: dw-pleadings
plugins.description: Motion drafting: suppression, 404(b) opposition, bond/release, and the pretrial motion library.

plugins.name: dw-trial-prep
plugins.description: Trial preparation: cross/direct exam, voir dire, jury instructions, exhibits, timelines, trial-day assistant, error preservation, theory tools, and investigator tasking.

plugins.name: dw-transcription
plugins.description: Media transcription routing and DMAR pipelines (Calcasieu + Rev) plus cross-case DMAR synthesis.

plugins.name: dw-disposition
plugins.description: Sentencing, habitual-offender audit, plea analysis, appeal, post-conviction relief, and case disposition.

plugins.name: dw-ops
plugins.description: Operational utilities: billing narratives, case-law research, client communications, court/jail tracker, evidence placeholders, image stamping.
